name: browser-use
headline: ai-design-components: UI/UX skills for development
short_description: AI design components enable rapid UI/UX and backend development with Claude. Operations teams use it to create consistent design systems, reducing development time. It integrates with React and TypeScript workflows, connecting design and development teams.
author: ancoleman

sections.overview:
AI Design Components is a comprehensive skill library containing 76 production-ready Claude Skills organized across 10 domains: frontend UI components, backend systems, DevOps pipelines, infrastructure as code, security patterns, developer productivity tools, data engineering, AI/ML operations, cloud provider patterns, and FinOps optimization. Each skill provides Claude with domain expertise, decision frameworks, and code patterns to accelerate development workflows. The collection supports full-stack development from React interfaces to Kubernetes deployments, enabling developers to leverage Claude's capabilities across the entire technology stack. Installation is available through an interactive installer script or selective plugin-by-plugin installation via Claude's plugin marketplace, allowing teams to adopt only the skills relevant to their projects.
Accelerate frontend development with 15 UI component and form building skills
Build backend systems faster using database, API, and authentication patterns
Set up CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows with DevOps skills
Deploy infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and Kubernetes skills
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ancoleman/ai-design-components`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
